historical_quarantine.policy: Old fragment matches, proposed keys, rosters, repaired phrases and answer-specific extraction choices are not active targets or validation criteria.
historical_quarantine.reuse_condition: Only reconsider an old result if an independently specified construction and selection rule reproduces it. Do not choose parameters to recover it.

acceptance_requirements: Record clue basis and parameter choices before running a proposed body extraction.
Define the recovered object type and population; it need not be English prose.
Specify what makes one object the outlier before reading its candidate answer.
Check the claimed construction forward, including reversibility where applicable.
Validate nontrivial predictions or structure beyond a short recognizable word.
Keep exploratory hypotheses distinct from author statements and literal source observations.

hypotheses.name: Forward layout model
hypotheses.prediction: Reconstruct all body whitespace and line endings from the unmodified letter stream without adding or removing letters.
hypotheses.result: Exact byte match. Does not identify the letter generator or final answer.

hypotheses.name: Role of the acrostic and seed
hypotheses.next_action: Compare the literal poem readings. Admit a recovery model only after it predicts an object type or structural property not chosen from an old fragment.
hypotheses.forbidden_shortcut: Do not assume either a book population or a cipher family from the token alone.

tests.basis: The literal acrostic and the previously verified seed; no old decoded fragment.
tests.prediction: A candidate reference should actually identify the book/number and be consistent with the poem imagery.
tests.scope: Pinned Gutenberg4300 metadata and episode1; fixed token queries blue, bowl*, stair*, laugh*, morning; exact poem-line matches.
tests.caveat: The reference and some source text were already seen, so this is not held-out validation or a significance test.

tests.basis: BLOOM can name a construction rather than a password; no dictionary or target-word queries.
tests.input_encoding: Unmodified body or explicit final-I removal; whole-number base26 A0 and bijective A1; big/little bytes; 0..7 lost zero bytes restored at the appropriate end.
tests.prohibited: No Vigenere, keyed alphabets, transpositions, arbitrary offsets, passwords or favorite-word membership probes.
formats: pybloom BloomFilter <dQQQQ with exact constructor dimensions and whole-packet bit-array size
pybloom ScalableBloomFilter <idQd plus count/size table and complete validated children
tests.success_prediction: A complete self-consistent container, not printable bytes, a bare word, or an appealing bit density.
tests.failure_meaning: Only these raw representations/formats are unsupported; it does not disprove Bloom-related constructions.
tests.outlier_gate: Even a valid container is not the final answer. Its object universe and outlier rule must be independently justified before querying membership.

hypotheses.assessment: Pinned metadata connects 4300 to Ulysses. Episode1 contains bowl/stair/morning imagery, but no literal poem lines and no token blue. Named-construction raw-schema test yields no container. These do not assign a cipher or answer class.

hypotheses.name: Original-row visual extraction
hypotheses.user_model: One original ciphertext row becomes one vertical strip; count its actual letters on either side of a justified zero.
hypotheses.next_action: Derive the zero/anchor and measurement from clues before testing a strip population.
hypotheses.forbidden_shortcut: No pooled-page substitute, free guide search for an old answer, or assumption that different ranges force an outlier.

hypotheses.name: Pinned book text as a running key
hypotheses.clue_basis: Test the supported reference as key material, rather than assuming the acrostic is a repeating cipher key or the answer belongs to a literary roster.
key_domains: all ASCII letters in pinned raw file
ASCII letters between exact Gutenberg START/END markers
ASCII letters from Stately opening to exact Gutenberg END marker
hypotheses.normalization: Keep ASCII A..Z/a..z only, uppercase, zero-based values. Start at normalized position0; no offset search, key repetition or row reset.
hypotheses.binary_representation: Whole-base26 A0/A1, both byte orders, restoring 0..7 lost zero bytes at the appropriate end.
accepted_endpoints: checksum-valid origin-zero gzip/zlib/bzip2/XZ consuming the packet
complete validated origin-zero pybloom filter/scalable container
hypotheses.excluded: No embedded-offset acceptance, static-pickle acceptance, dictionary words, names, spelling repair, transposition or phase search.
hypotheses.success_prediction: Recover a complete structured object with exact letter-stage roundtrip; do not claim an answer until a population and outlier rule are justified.
hypotheses.failure_meaning: Reject only these running-key/representation/endpoint combinations, not the reference itself or all book-based constructions.

result.note: All letter-stage roundtrips pass; reversibility alone is not plaintext evidence.

hypotheses.name: Give/take operand and operation
hypotheses.basis: The two literal poem lines may describe construction, recovery or interpretation rather than two cipher layers.
hypotheses.next_action: Identify what is given or taken and state a forward structural prediction before applying a change to the body.
not_assumed: insertion or deletion of a marker
hypotheses.success_gate: The operand and operation must be justified without a historical candidate or an extra layer added merely after a failed test.

hypotheses.name: User-proposed colour replacement in the poem
hypotheses.origin: User suggests that blue is the outlier and should be replaced using the book.
hypotheses.book_evidence: The pinned first episode describes a bowl of white china holding green sluggish bile.

alternative_reading.body_test: not included in this primary test

hypotheses.limits: The colour mismatch is a hypothesis, not an author-confirmed error. The original poem remains unchanged. No previous candidate word is used.

test_roles.endpoint: Complete origin-zero JSON/checksummed compressed packet or validated Bloom container, after whole-base26 A0/A1 in either byte order with 0..7 restored zero bytes.
Valid 16-byte authentication tag in the already bounded AES-GCM/AES-EAX/ChaCha20-Poly1305 packet formats and key derivations.

hypotheses.excluded: No repeating-key plus AEAD stack, extra routes, changed O initials, key-phase search, dictionary lookup or preferred-word acceptance.
hypotheses.success_gate: First recover an independently validated object; the object population and its outlier must still be explained.
hypotheses.interpretation: Green remains a book-grounded candidate replacement. Neither tested key role recovers an object. No population or outlier solution has been established.

hypotheses.name: Vessel-colour alternative to green
hypotheses.basis: The same episode1 passage calls the bowl white china. A meaningful GLOOM word is not grounds to exclude WLOOM.
hypotheses.protocol: Exactly the R5 repeating-key and standalone-password roles, replacing only the key and its three case variants. No stacks or extra cipher family.
hypotheses.reference_audit: Enumerate all exact bowl/bowls tokens in the whole story, episode and ±40 ASCII word-token context; fixed blue/green/white/yellow/black queries. Exploratory, not held-out. Nearby colours need not modify bowls.
hypotheses.important_new_alternative: Episode5 cold black marble bowl is followed closely by I’m in mourning myself. Blue -> black retains BLOOM. Yellow soup is a further bowl-content colour in episode10; no new yellow-key search was run.

hypotheses.name: Signed-cell preflight for an invertible Bloom lookup table
basis: One given / one taken can mean insertions and deletions, rather than shifts of O initials.
User-author clarification allows construction and interpretation layers.
hypotheses.reference: gavinandresen/IBLT_Cplusplus logical entry fields count:int32, keySum:uint64, keyCheck:uint32, valueSum:variable bytes; 4 hash partitions; MurmurHash3 checksum seed11.
hypotheses.important_limit: The reference has no wire serializer. Packed field widths below are an explicit hypothetical representation, not an attributed official format.
hypotheses.bytes: Whole-base26 A0/A1, both orders, 0..7 restored zero bytes; no additional cipher, route, offset-key or hash generator.

preflight.alignment: Every byte residue within a stride; longest consecutive run, allowing unknown framing without selecting an answer.

hypotheses.prediction: At least one representation of a small ordinary packed IBLT should contain a long periodic stripe of bounded signed counts.
hypotheses.gate: A stripe is only a structural lead, not an accepted object. Any flag must next satisfy checksum, bucket placement, complete peeling and forward reconstruction before identifying items or an outlier.
hypotheses.excluded: Not every IBLT variant, integer width, value size, compressed counter encoding, encryption, or serialization is covered.
hypotheses.interpretation: Preflight negative only, not an accepted-object decoder or a universal IBLT exclusion. No checksum/peeling implementation was used to claim recovered objects.

representation_followup.status: fieldwise rule tested separately, required field constraints fail

hypotheses.name: Per-field base26 encoding of a key-only IBLT
hypotheses.basis: R7 does not cover fieldwise integer encoding. The pinned reference independently supplies signed count32, key64 and checksum32, four hash partitions and checksum seed11. Zero-length valueSum is a supported key-only case.
hypotheses.wire_hypothesis: Each unsigned bit pattern is A0 positional base26, most-significant letter first, padded with A to ceil(bits/log2(26)) letters: count7, key14, checksum7. Counts use signed32 two’s complement. No official serializer is attributed to the reference.
layouts: field-major count array, key array, checksum array

letter_paths.reason_for_BLOOM: Literal source acrostic, preserved by the independently recorded black-bowl reading.

predictions: Exact cell count, no padding repairs; nonzero cell count divisible by four.
All count/check fields fit uint32 and key fields fit uint64; absolute signed counts at most1,000,000.
Pure cells have count +/-1, the seed11 MurmurHash3 checksum and correct four-partition bucket positions.
Complete peeling leaves every cell empty; re-insertion exactly reconstructs all input fields.
hypotheses.gate: No population/outlier claim from divisibility or bounds alone. Recover numeric keys only after complete checksum/bucket/peeling/forward validation. Numeric-key interpretation and an outlier rule would still remain separate.
hypotheses.excluded: No A1 fixed-width zero convention, shifted field starts, headers, bit truncation, variable values, extra cipher, extra key phase, transposition, changed O initials or dictionary targets.
hypotheses.interpretation: Divisibility fits but the required bit widths and signed count bounds fail. No population recovered.

hypotheses.name: Colour replacement followed by literal unit shifts of the two O initials
hypotheses.basis: User-proposed replacement is combined with one given / one taken as +1 / -1 applied to those lines’ own O initials. Unchanged B/L/M positions are an explicit hypothesis; no cipher operation or last-line role is confirmed.
hypotheses.reset_boundary: BLPNM is a historical proposed key; here it is only a source-derived baseline under the declared rule. No old fragments, desired words or previous purported answers can validate a result.
hypotheses.protocol: Same bounded literal repeating-key and standalone authenticated-password alternatives as R5/R6; only explicit derived keys and their upper/lower/title case variants change. Not a GLOOM-then-GLPNM encryption stack.
hypotheses.success_gate: Complete registered structured object or valid authentication tag. No dictionary scores or preferred words. A recovered object would still require independent interpretation and an outlier rule.
hypotheses.excluded: No inverse order, arbitrary letter changes, extra key phase, new cipher family, transposition, added plaintext layer or field repair.

hypotheses.name: The new colour-derived strings as byte-XOR keys, not letter keys
hypotheses.basis: The acrostic/derived-string role remains unassigned. Repeating ASCII bytes or a SHA256-derived byte key is a direct reversible alternative to letterwise arithmetic or an authenticated-encryption password. This is not applied after another decryption.
hypotheses.operation: Repeating byte XOR, phase0, on raw whole-base26 A0/A1; two byte orders; full/drop final I; restore0..7 zero bytes.
hypotheses.gate: Complete origin-zero registered JSON/checksummed compressed/Bloom packet. Whole printable ASCII packets >=64 bytes are separately flagged for interpretation. Origin-zero NPY or SQLite signatures are diagnostics only, never accepted as complete objects.
hypotheses.limits: No letterwise stage first, arbitrary byte phase, extra cipher, route, repair, word targets or unvalidated magic acceptance. Old BLOOM/BLPNM byte-key grids are not rerun.

hypotheses.name: Literal book-colour words instead of their resulting acrostics
hypotheses.basis: The user requested substituting blue using the book. That does not require using the corrected initial. Black has an explicit bowl/mourning context; green and white describe contents/vessel in episode1.
hypotheses.roles: Same independently tested repeating-letter, standalone authenticated-password, and direct raw-byte XOR roles as earlier probes; only the literal strings change. No stacked encryption.
hypotheses.bounds: Phase0; existing three letter operations, raw ASCII/SHA256 XOR material, five AEAD key derivations, upper/lower/title password cases; full/drop I, whole-base26 A0/A1, either byte order, restore0..7 zero bytes.
hypotheses.gate: Complete registered packets, valid tags, or separately labelled whole-printable/NPY/SQLite diagnostics. No wordlist or favoured plaintext.

hypotheses.name: Keyword alphabet as the numeric representation, colour word as the password
hypotheses.basis: A keyword can define the ordered digit alphabet rather than a periodic key. The literal/corrected initials and the replacement word are distinct clue roles. The primary pair is literal BLOOM digit alphabet with BLACK password, preserving the acrostic under the black/mourning reading.
hypotheses.alphabet_rule: Deduplicate keyword in order; append unused A..Z. Most-significant digit first. No other alphabet permutation, Caesar offset or reversal.
hypotheses.representation: Raw original letters only, full/drop final I; whole-integer A0/A1; either byte order; restore0..7 zero bytes.
hypotheses.endpoints: Inspect complete decoded packets directly, then separately test the already specified authenticated packet modes with explicit colour-word passwords. No letterwise cipher or XOR stage first.
hypotheses.bounds: Upper/lower/title cases and existing five password derivations, five mode/nonce pairs, two packet framings, 16-byte tags, empty AAD.
hypotheses.overlap: Direct BLOOM-keyed alphabet packet checks overlap historical baseline. The new colour-password combinations and other admitted alphabets are specified explicitly, not claimed as entirely new cipher families.
hypotheses.gate: Exact glyph-map and numeric roundtrips check implementation only. Complete object/tag required; no population or outlier is inferred from keyword meaning or a header alone.

hypotheses.name: Book passages as exact running-key addresses, not passwords
hypotheses.basis: The user-proposed replacement locates actual passages. The explicit black-bowl/mourning pairing supplies a location rather than requiring a key word. R3 tested only three canonical start0 domains, not these clue-bound addresses.

hypotheses.packet_representations: Same whole-base26 A0/A1, two byte orders and 0..7 restored zero bytes as R3.
hypotheses.gate: Complete origin-zero registered structured packet, no English-score or favourite-word gate. Letter roundtrip is implementation evidence only.
hypotheses.caution: Passages were seen before this test; this is exploratory clue-based hypothesis testing, not held-out reference validation. No official instruction specifies an anchor.

historical_negatives: Keep their documented scopes. Do not repeat unchanged searches or treat them as proof that all other constructions fail.
next_gate: Representation-first: test numeral/packet invariants before admitting more semantic keyword guesses. A possible future check is repeated-glyph consistency against canonical binary prefixes under digit relabelling; it is not registered or executed in this pass.
